Seamless 360 degree cylindrical panorama strip, a skybox backdrop for a stylised video game with the stylised realism of a modern Nintendo golf game: believable light and atmosphere, bold saturated colour, slightly painterly. A perfectly straight level horizon line runs across the whole image at one fifth of the height from the bottom edge. Below the horizon only a cold deep blue-green sea with small whitecaps. Above it a dramatic maritime sky: bright clear blue with brilliant white sunlit clouds over most of the panorama, but along one third of the horizon a dark slate storm front with grey rain curtains and shafts of sunlight breaking through its edge. The sun sits in the left third, half way up the sky, a small bright disc behind a wisp of thin cloud. A few far low headlands and pale cliffs sit tiny on the horizon. No foreground objects, no people, no animals, no text, no logos, no real landmarks, no lens flare streaks, no vignette, no frame. The left edge and the right edge match exactly so the strip wraps around seamlessly.
